prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact Song dynasty farmer harvesting grain while squatting, seen from the same high overhead angle as the reference. Keep his identity: black hair in a top bun with blue tie, blue jacket with rolled cream cuffs, khaki trousers, straw sandals, a small iron sickle in his right hand. He squats in the same place in all cells; his feet and knees do not move. Cell 1 (left) = rest pose matching the reference: left hand gathering a bundle of golden grain stalks, sickle held low near the stalks. Cell 2 (middle) = cutting: left hand grips the stalks firmly, right arm pulls the sickle back through the stalk bases near the ground, shoulders turning slightly with the pull. Cell 3 (right) = gathering: both hands lift the cut sheaf and lay it across his left forearm, sickle tucked in the right hand, head following the sheaf. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full figure per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so tools and hands never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Make every cell match the reference figure and match each other as strictly as possible.
